activation: SSH with the native exclusive switch lock, stop and wait, then same-filesystem atomic config rename and start; verified health or automatic config-only rollback
validation: exact previous priority and unique group
same saved-profile and previous-config bytes before and after activation
rollback: Restore the verified original config bytes while holding the same lock; never restore or rewrite saved profiles, cache or Tailscale state
saved_profiles: Kept byte-identical. The running config is external; selecting a saved profile restores that profile configuration and priority.
